info.name: Elaro API
info.description:
All configuration is done through this API. Reads of data are open on the local network; all writes and settings reads require the admin bearer token printed on first start. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. `/v1` is additive-only once released.

Generated from docs/OpenAPI.json (v1.0.0). Every operation is included, grouped by tag. Admin operations use Bearer `{{adminToken}}`; open reads use no auth. Test scripts capture ids into collection variables (ruleId, webhookId, alertId, externalId, lastSeq, cursor).

item.name: 00 Quickstart — USGS end to end
item.description: Run in order (Collection Runner works). Set `adminToken` first (from `docker compose logs elaro | grep -A3 "ELARO ADMIN TOKEN"`). Enables USGS earthquakes, creates an enter-mode M≥4.5 rule, waits, and reads data back. SSE requests are left in the Streams folder (run them manually; Postman shows events live).
